_comment: Labelled Playwright failures for measuring AI classification accuracy. Expected labels use the §16 categories.

cases.failure:
Test: Checkout > TC23 Order completion
Step: click Finish on the order overview, then expect the confirmation header.
Error: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed
Locator: getByTestId('complete-header')
Expected: "Thank you for your order!"
Received: element not found. Page title is still "Checkout: Overview" and the Finish button is visible and enabled. No console errors. The same test passed yesterday on the same test code.

Test: Cart > TC13 Add one product
Error: TimeoutError: locator.click: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.
Call log: waiting for getByTestId('chekout')
The cart page rendered normally and contains a button with data-test="checkout". The test file was edited in the last commit.

Test: Authentication > TC01 Valid login [webkit]
Error: browserType.launch: Host system is missing dependencies to run browsers. Missing libraries: libgstcodecparsers-1.0.so.0, libflite.so.1, libavif.so.13
The same test passes on chromium and firefox on this machine.

Test: API: products > GET /products returns the catalog
Error: apiRequestContext.fetch: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3001
No HTTP response was received. The API server process is not listening on that port.

Test: Product > TC12 Product price validation
Error: listing price of Sauce Labs Backpack: expect(received).toBe(expected)
Expected: 39.99
Received: 29.99
The expected value comes from test-data/staging/products.json, which was edited yesterday. The product catalog specification and production both list the Backpack at $29.99.

Test: API: cart > Add an item
Error: Expected HTTP 201, got 401
Response body: {"error":{"code":"UNAUTHORIZED","message":"Invalid or expired token"}}
The token was issued 2 hours ago; tokens expire after 1 hour. Login itself succeeded.
